title: French property prices by commune · settling-map
description: Free interactive map of French property prices: median sale price per m² by commune and how reliable each figure is, built from open DVF data.
h1: French property prices, and how reliable they are
intro: A free interactive map: for every commune in metropolitan France, the median sale price per m² of houses and flats, with the number of sales behind it, the period covered and a reliability indicator.

The figures come from the property transactions file (DVF) published by the French tax administration, aggregated by commune. Communes that rest on few sales are marked with a texture on the map, and Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte, which are not in the DVF database, are labelled as such rather than shown as cheap.
features: See the median price per m² of every commune, for all dwellings, houses or flats.
Read how solid the figure is: fewer than 10 sales, no sale kept, outside the DVF database.
Search for a commune, share a link to an exact view, use the map in French or English.
Use the app with no account, no cookie and no individual tracking, and install it on your device.
noscript: This interactive map needs JavaScript. The median price per m² by commune is computed from DVF data; the method is described on the Method page.
footer: Data: DGFiP/Etalab (DVF), IGN, OpenStreetMap. Licence Ouverte v2.0.
